# Pause Match Time

Source: [4399](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4399); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Pause Match Time](../../api/actions/pause-match-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4399-n1"></a>

- Pause Match Time pauses only the match timer: players, objectives and game-mode advancement remain active.

<a id="wiki-4399-n2"></a>

- The archive says game lifetime closure still occurs after 4h30, or 1h30 in Practice Range.

Source limitations:
